## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Tours, France. It starts at Rue de Pineau.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Château d’Azay-le-Rideau is an innovative blend of 16th-century building styles in the beautiful Loire Valley. Surrounded by 8 hectares of English-style gardens, this French Renaissance castle is as beautiful as it is storied.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €14.60. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 287 ratings and 119 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
